title: Quality over Quantity: Rethinking Data and Model Assumptions for Bengali Coreference Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.35114v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multilingual transformer models are often assumed to generalise across languages, but their effectiveness for coreference resolution in low-resource settings remains unverified. We investigate this gap in Bengali, a language with over 250 million speakers but limited annotated coreference resources. We evaluate transformer-based pre-trained encoders under multiple settings, including zero-shot, fine-tuning, data augmentation, and cross-lingual transfer. Our results challenge several common assumptions about model generalisation and data efficiency in low-resource NLP. We demonstrate that a small amount of high-quality annotated data significantly outperforms larger mixed-quality datasets (p < 0.01). We find that data augmentation, particularly back-translation, does not improve performance and can degrade results in coreference resolution. translated_title: 质量胜于数量：重新思考孟加拉语共指消解的数据与模型假设
translated_abstract: 多语言Transformer模型通常被假设能够跨语言泛化，但其在低资源环境下共指消解任务中的有效性尚未得到验证。我们在孟加拉语中研究了这一空白——孟加拉语拥有超过2.5亿使用者，但标注的共指消解资源十分有限。我们在多种设置下评估了基于Transformer的预训练编码器，包括零样本学习、微调、数据增强和跨语言迁移。我们的结果挑战了关于低资源NLP中模型泛化与数据效率的若干常见假设。我们证明，少量高质量标注数据显著优于更大的混合质量数据集（p < 0.01）。我们发现数据增强，尤其是回译，并不能提升性能，反而可能降低共指消解的效果。跨语言迁移同样表现出不一致性：从英语这类语言距离较远的语言进行迁移会降低……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究针对孟加拉语共指消解任务，证明少量高质量标注数据显著优于更大的混合质量数据集，而数据增强（如回译）无益甚至有害，跨语言迁移效果也不一致，从而挑战了低资源NLP中关于模型泛化与数据效率的常见假设。
en_tdlr: This study on Bengali coreference resolution demonstrates that a small amount of high-quality annotated data significantly outperforms larger mixed-quality datasets, while data augmentation such as back-translation can degrade performance and cross-lingual transfer remains inconsistent, challenging common assumptions about model generalization and data efficiency in low-resource NLP.
